materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 沈阳市·沈阳故宫

context.zh-CN: 沈阳故宫始建于1625年，建筑可按东、中、西路理解。
context.en: The Shenyang Imperial Palace was founded in 1625; its buildings can be understood through its eastern, central and western sections.

example.zh-CN: 东、中、西路是观察宫殿布局的具体线索。
example.en: The three sections offer a concrete way to explore the palace layout.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 沈阳市·沈阳工业博物馆

context.zh-CN: 沈阳工业博物馆利用原铸造厂车间展示工业历史。
context.en: The Shenyang Industrial Museum uses former foundry workshops to present industrial history.

example.zh-CN: 车间本身也是理解工业生产空间的例子。
example.en: The workshops themselves illustrate the spaces used for industrial production.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 沈阳市·沈阳“九·一八“历史博物馆

context.zh-CN: 九一八历史博物馆位于柳条湖事件相关地点附近。
context.en: The September 18 History Museum stands near the site associated with the Liutiaohu incident.

example.zh-CN: 纪念馆把历史事件与具体地点联系起来。
example.en: The museum connects a historical event to a specific place.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 大连市·大连博物馆景区

context.zh-CN: 大连博物馆的近代大连展览讲述1840年至1949年的城市历史。
context.en: Dalian Museum's modern Dalian exhibition covers the city's history from 1840 to 1949.

example.zh-CN: 展览的时间范围有助于区分近代城市史与更早历史。
example.en: The exhibition's date range distinguishes modern urban history from earlier periods.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 大连市·旅顺日俄监狱旧址博物馆

context.zh-CN: 旅顺日俄监狱旧址保留了监狱建筑与相关展示。
context.en: The former Russian and Japanese prison in Lushun preserves prison buildings and related displays.

example.zh-CN: 原有劳役工场可用于认识监禁与强迫劳动的历史。
example.en: The former labour workshops help explain the history of imprisonment and forced labour.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 大连市·东鸡冠山景区

context.zh-CN: 东鸡冠山景区包含北堡垒等日俄战争相关遗址。
context.en: Dongjiguanshan includes the North Fort and other sites associated with the Russo-Japanese War.

example.zh-CN: 北堡垒是把战争历史与防御设施联系起来的例子。
example.en: The North Fort connects wartime history with defensive structures.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 鞍山市·辽宁千山景区

context.zh-CN: 千山的名称与峰峦众多的传统说法有关。
context.en: Qianshan's name is associated with a traditional account of its numerous peaks.

example.zh-CN: “九百九十九峰”应作为传统说法介绍，不应当作精确测量。
example.en: The account of 999 peaks should be introduced as a traditional saying, rather than a precise survey.

materials.subject: artifacts
materials.title: 鞍山市·玉佛苑

context.zh-CN: 玉佛苑以玉石雕刻与佛教艺术为展示特色。
context.en: Yufoyuan features jade carving and Buddhist art.

example.zh-CN: 同一玉石雕像的正面与背面分别呈现释迦牟尼与观音形象。
example.en: The front and back of the same jade sculpture depict Shakyamuni and Guanyin respectively.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 鞍山市·鞍钢集团展览馆景区

context.zh-CN: 鞍钢集团展览馆利用原烧结厂建筑展示企业与工业历史。
context.en: The Ansteel exhibition hall uses a former sintering-plant building to present company and industrial history.

example.zh-CN: 照片和实物与原厂房共同构成工业记忆的展示。
example.en: Photographs, objects and the former factory building together present industrial memory.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 抚顺市·雷锋纪念馆

context.zh-CN: 雷锋纪念馆以雷锋的生平与相关精神主题组织展示。
context.en: The Lei Feng Memorial Hall presents Lei Feng's life and associated themes of public service.

example.zh-CN: 生平陈列可以按人物经历理解纪念馆内容。
example.en: Biographical displays offer a way to follow the memorial through a person's experiences.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 抚顺市·赫图阿拉城

context.zh-CN: 赫图阿拉城位于新宾，官方介绍将其与1616年后金建立联系起来。
context.en: Hetuala in Xinbin is associated in the official profile with the establishment of Later Jin in 1616.

example.zh-CN: 古城遗址可用于讨论早期满族历史与政治中心。
example.en: The city site provides a concrete setting for discussing early Manchu history and political centres.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 抚顺市·三块石国家森林公园

context.zh-CN: 三块石景区同时介绍森林景观与抗联相关遗址。
context.en: Sankuaishi's profile describes both forest landscapes and sites associated with the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army.

example.zh-CN: 自然环境与历史遗址是理解同一地点的两种角度。
example.en: The natural environment and historical sites provide two perspectives on the same place.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 本溪市·五女山景区

context.zh-CN: 五女山的遗址与博物馆呈现高句丽相关历史。
context.en: Wunushan's archaeological site and museum present history associated with Goguryeo.

example.zh-CN: 遗址与出土材料的展示可以相互补充。
example.en: The archaeological site and displays of excavated material complement each other.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 本溪市·本溪水洞风景名胜区

context.zh-CN: 本溪水洞是以地下河和喀斯特地貌为特色的景区。
context.en: Benxi Water Cave features an underground river and karst landscapes.

example.zh-CN: 钟乳石与石笋是认识洞穴地貌的具体例子。
example.en: Stalactites and stalagmites offer concrete examples of cave formations.

materials.subject: belief
materials.title: 本溪市·铁刹山风景区

context.zh-CN: 铁刹山的官方介绍将其与道教龙门派传统联系起来。
context.en: Tieshashan's official profile associates it with the Longmen tradition of Daoism.

example.zh-CN: 八宝云光洞及石刻可作为观察宗教景观的线索。
example.en: Babao Yunguang Cave and inscriptions offer ways to explore the religious landscape.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 丹东市·抗美援朝纪念馆

context.zh-CN: 抗美援朝纪念馆通过展馆、纪念塔及全景画介绍相关历史。
context.en: The memorial to the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea presents the subject through exhibition halls, a memorial tower and a panoramic painting.

example.zh-CN: 全景画是一种利用大幅场景讲述历史的展示方式。
example.en: A panoramic painting presents history through a large surrounding scene.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 丹东市·鸭绿江风景名胜区

context.zh-CN: 鸭绿江景区沿江展开，官方介绍包含断桥和虎山等地点。
context.en: The Yalu River scenic area follows the river; its official profile includes the Broken Bridge and Hushan.

example.zh-CN: 沿江地点可以按河流空间关系理解。
example.en: Riverside sites can be understood through their positions along the river.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 丹东市·东港市大鹿岛景区

context.zh-CN: 大鹿岛位于东港市孤山镇相关海域，是沿海岛屿景观。
context.en: Dalu Island, associated with Gushan in Donggang, is a coastal island landscape.

example.zh-CN: 岛屿与海岸的关系可作为理解当地地理的例子。
example.en: The relationship between island and coast helps explain the local geography.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 锦州市·锦州市博物馆

context.zh-CN: 锦州市博物馆结合馆内陈列与大广济寺相关历史建筑介绍地方文化。
context.en: Jinzhou Museum presents local culture through indoor exhibitions and historical buildings associated with Daguangji Temple.

example.zh-CN: 寺塔与博物馆陈列提供不同类型的文化材料。
example.en: A temple pagoda and museum displays offer different kinds of cultural evidence.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 锦州市·辽沈战役纪念馆

context.zh-CN: 辽沈战役纪念馆通过战史、支前与英烈主题展示相关历史。
context.en: The Liaoshen Campaign Memorial presents campaign history, civilian support and commemoration.

example.zh-CN: 支前主题展示有助于认识战事之外的社会参与。
example.en: Displays about civilian support help explain participation beyond battlefield action.

materials.subject: belief
materials.title: 锦州市·义县奉国寺景区

context.zh-CN: 奉国寺始建于辽代，官方介绍给出的创建年代为1020年。
context.en: Fengguo Temple was founded in the Liao period; the official profile gives 1020 as its founding date.

example.zh-CN: 大雄殿的木构建筑与七尊佛像是观察寺院艺术的具体例子。
example.en: The timber hall and seven Buddha statues provide concrete examples of temple art.

materials.subject: folklore
materials.title: 营口市·鲅鱼圈区望儿山景区

context.zh-CN: 望儿山的名称与母亲盼望儿子归来的民间传说有关。
context.en: Wangershan's name is linked to a folk story about a mother awaiting her son's return.

example.zh-CN: 这个故事适合作为民间传说讲述，不能当作已经证实的历史事件。
example.en: The story should be presented as folklore rather than a verified historical event.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 营口市·盖州市万福赤山旅游景区

context.zh-CN: 赤山位于盖州万福镇，官方介绍同时涉及自然景观与祈福活动。
context.en: Chishan in Wanfu, Gaizhou, is described through natural scenery and prayer-related activities.

example.zh-CN: 自然游览与祈福活动是该介绍中不同的体验主题。
example.en: Nature exploration and prayer-related activities are distinct themes in the profile.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 营口市·辽宁团山国家级海洋公园景区

context.zh-CN: 团山国家级海洋公园的介绍以北海沿岸景观为主题。
context.en: The Tuanshan marine park profile focuses on the Beihai coastal landscape.

example.zh-CN: 海岸景观可以帮助理解营口的滨海地理。
example.en: The coastal landscape helps explain Yingkou's maritime geography.

materials.subject: crafts
materials.title: 阜新市·玛瑙特色小镇景区

context.zh-CN: 阜新玛瑙小镇位于十家子镇，介绍涉及玛瑙雕刻及相关产业。
context.en: Fuxin's agate town in Shijiazi presents agate carving and associated industries.

example.zh-CN: 玛瑙雕刻是将材料加工与地方工艺联系起来的例子。
example.en: Agate carving connects material processing with local craftsmanship.

materials.subject: artifacts
materials.title: 阜新市·海棠山风景区

context.zh-CN: 海棠山以摩崖造像及藏传佛教相关文化景观为特色。
context.en: Haitangshan features rock-cut images and a cultural landscape associated with Tibetan Buddhism.

example.zh-CN: 摩崖造像指直接在岩石表面雕刻的形象。
example.en: Rock-cut images are figures carved directly into rock surfaces.

materials.subject: belief
materials.title: 阜新市·瑞应寺风景区

context.zh-CN: 瑞应寺的官方介绍给出的创建年代为1669年。
context.en: Ruiying Temple's official profile gives 1669 as its founding date.

example.zh-CN: 寺院可作为认识阜新藏传佛教文化的具体地点。
example.en: The temple offers a specific place for exploring Tibetan Buddhist culture in Fuxin.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 辽阳市·辽阳博物馆景区

context.zh-CN: 辽阳博物馆展示汉、辽、金、明、清等时期的材料。
context.en: Liaoyang Museum displays material from periods including Han, Liao, Jin, Ming and Qing.

example.zh-CN: 王尔烈寿屏是官方介绍提到的具体馆藏例子。
example.en: Wang Erlie's birthday screen is a specific collection example mentioned in the official profile.

materials.subject: belief
materials.title: 辽阳市·广佑寺景区

context.zh-CN: 广佑寺的介绍涉及佛教建筑与木雕佛像。
context.en: Guangyou Temple's profile describes Buddhist buildings and a wooden Buddha sculpture.

example.zh-CN: 建筑与雕塑可以分别从空间和造型角度观察。
example.en: Buildings and sculptures can be explored through spatial design and form respectively.

materials.subject: history_geography
materials.title: 辽阳市·太子河历史文化风光带景区

context.zh-CN: 太子河文化旅游带的介绍包含燕州城、东京城与东京陵等历史地点。
context.en: The Taizi River cultural tourism belt's profile includes historical sites such as Yanzhou City, Dongjing City and Dongjing Tombs.

example.zh-CN: 沿河的历史地点提供了按地理位置组织文化游览的例子。
example.en: Historical sites along the river illustrate how geography can organise a cultural itinerary.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 铁岭市·铁煤蒸汽机车博物馆

context.zh-CN: 铁煤蒸汽机车博物馆位于调兵山，展示蒸汽机车相关材料。
context.en: The Tiefa steam-locomotive museum in Diaobingshan displays material associated with steam locomotives.

example.zh-CN: 机车模型、照片和机车实物是不同类型的展示材料。
example.en: Models, photographs and locomotives are different forms of display material.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 铁岭市·西丰县城子山风景区

context.zh-CN: 西丰城子山的官方介绍涉及古城墙及城内相关遗迹。
context.en: The Chengzishan profile in Xifeng describes ancient city walls and associated remains.

example.zh-CN: 城墙与蓄水设施可以帮助认识古城的防御与生活空间。
example.en: Walls and water-storage facilities help explain defence and everyday space in an ancient city.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 铁岭市·周恩来同志少年读书旧址纪念馆景区

context.zh-CN: 周恩来读书旧址与银冈书院相联系。
context.en: Zhou Enlai's former study site is associated with Yingan Academy.

example.zh-CN: 官方介绍记载周恩来于1910年在这里读书。
example.en: The official profile records that Zhou Enlai studied here in 1910.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 朝阳市·牛河梁国家考古遗址公园

context.zh-CN: 牛河梁遗址位于凌源与建平之间，是红山文化相关考古地点。
context.en: Niuheliang, between Lingyuan and Jianping, is an archaeological site associated with Hongshan culture.

example.zh-CN: 庙、祭坛与积石冢是官方介绍中的遗迹类型。
example.en: Temples, altars and stone burial mounds are types of remains described in the profile.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 朝阳市·凤凰山景区

context.zh-CN: 朝阳凤凰山的介绍涉及寺院、塔及山地景观。
context.en: Chaoyang's Fenghuangshan profile describes temples, pagodas and mountain scenery.

example.zh-CN: 凌霄塔与摩云塔是其中具体的建筑例子。
example.en: Lingxiao Pagoda and Moyun Pagoda are specific architectural examples.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 朝阳市·辽宁朝阳鸟化石国家地质公园景区

context.zh-CN: 朝阳鸟化石国家地质公园展示化石及相关地质材料。
context.en: Chaoyang's bird-fossil geopark displays fossils and associated geological material.

example.zh-CN: 化石标本与发掘展示有助于区分展品和发现地点。
example.en: Fossil specimens and excavation displays help distinguish objects from discovery sites.

materials.subject: artifacts
materials.title: 盘锦市·辽河碑林公园

context.zh-CN: 辽河碑林的官方介绍将其创建年代列为1985年。
context.en: The Liaohe Stele Forest's official profile gives 1985 as its establishment date.

example.zh-CN: 书法碑刻可以从文字内容与书写形式两个角度观察。
example.en: Calligraphic steles can be explored through their text and their written forms.

materials.subject: artifacts
materials.title: 盘锦市·广厦艺术街

context.zh-CN: 广厦艺术街的介绍包含画廊、艺术工作室与工艺品店。
context.en: Guangsha Art Street's profile describes galleries, artists' studios and craft shops.

example.zh-CN: 工作室与画廊展示了艺术创作和展示的不同空间。
example.en: Studios and galleries show different spaces for creating and displaying art.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 盘锦市·盘锦特产博物园

context.zh-CN: 辽河口特产博物园的介绍以大米、河蟹、烧烤与芦苇工艺等地方主题展开。
context.en: The Liaohe estuary specialty museum park's profile covers local themes such as rice, river crabs, barbecue and reed crafts.

example.zh-CN: 芦苇工艺是将当地材料与手工制作联系起来的例子。
example.en: Reed crafts connect a local material with handmade production.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 葫芦岛市·九门口长城景区

context.zh-CN: 九门口长城的介绍强调跨河城墙与桥体相结合的结构。
context.en: The Jiumenkou Great Wall profile describes a structure combining a river-crossing wall and bridge.

example.zh-CN: 跨河结构体现了防御设施对地形的适应。
example.en: The river-crossing structure illustrates how defensive works adapt to terrain.

materials.subject: sites
materials.title: 葫芦岛市·兴城市古城景区

context.zh-CN: 兴城古城的官方介绍给出的创建年代为明代1428年。
context.en: Xingcheng's ancient city's official profile gives 1428 in the Ming period as its founding date.

example.zh-CN: 城墙、文庙、钟鼓楼和祖氏石坊提供不同的建筑观察对象。
example.en: The walls, Confucian temple, bell-and-drum tower and Zu family archways offer different architectural examples.

materials.subject: museums
materials.title: 葫芦岛市·塔山阻击战纪念馆

context.zh-CN: 塔山纪念馆通过战役陈列及支前等主题介绍塔山战役。
context.en: The Tashan Memorial Hall presents the campaign through battle-history displays and themes including civilian support.

example.zh-CN: 支前主题可以帮助理解战争与当地社会的联系。
example.en: The civilian-support theme helps explain connections between war and local society.
